title: Kalmykian president's debrief with Kissinger and Gorbachev
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Kalmykian president's debrief with Kissinger and Gorbachev, about 1990s at Russia, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: >> But he said that he debriefed with Kissinger and Kissinger. He said he met with Gorbachev and Kissinger and then he suddenly asked, "Well, how was it? I didn't understand."

plain: Podcast host Jesse Michels relays a story about the president of Kalmykia, a region of Russia, in the 1990s. According to Michels, the president said he met with Mikhail Gorbachev, the last leader of the Soviet Union, and Henry Kissinger, a former top American diplomat, and afterwards was suddenly asked "Well, how was it?" in a way he did not understand. Michels tells it as part of a conversation about aliens, as a hint that powerful people may have discussed something hidden.
